items.t: What Is Visa (V) Facing After The $38 Billion Swipe Fee Ruling Delay?
items.sum: Visa (NYSE: V) faces renewed legal uncertainty after a US federal judge deferred a ruling on a proposed US$38b swipe fee settlement. The case, involving Visa and Mastercard interchange fees charged to merchants, could proceed to a full trial as late as 2027. items.t: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
items.sum: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.
